verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships its own interactive Swagger UI API reference, generated from an OpenAPI 3.0.0 spec with 67 /v1 paths. It is served at /api/docs on each self-hosted or desktop instance, so calls can run against a live instance with an API key. The caveat is that this reference exists only on the user's own instance. There is no vendor-hosted or public demo reference, and probes of the docs site for an OpenAPI spec returned 404. Missing for 10: a public hosted interactive reference, explicit documentation of runnable request examples or try-it-out, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can find the API documentation for available endpoints on your instance at /api/docs
API endpoints that enable programmatic reading, writing, and updating of your AnythingLLM instance. UI supplied by Swagger.io.
